title: key.rs: EcdhEs variant will never be passed to decrypt_cek() — should be doc(hidden)
description: smime-tree/src/key.rs:97 — KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs is documented as 'Reserved; currently not produced by decrypt()' and the decrypt_cek() doc says implementations do not need to handle it. Despite being public, the variant is dead from the caller's perspective. An implementor who adds an EcdhEs arm to decrypt_cek() is writing dead code. Fix: mark EcdhEs with #[doc(hidden)] and add a clear comment that it will never be passed to decrypt_cek().
